name: Vidocu API
description:
Turn videos into subtitles, voiceover, help articles and exports.

Authenticate with an API key (`Authorization: Bearer vdo_live_...`) or an OAuth 2.0 access token. Long-running operations return `202` with a `jobId` you poll via `GET /v1/jobs/{id}`, or you can subscribe to webhooks.

This spec is generated from the server's own validation schemas.
